name: Youseph El-Khouly
heroSub: CS at the University of Guelph, currently building AI systems at Backboard.io. I ship fast, and I ship a lot.
about: I'm a CS student who'd rather build than talk about building — happiest with something shipping in production.

Over four internships I've shipped AI chatbots with RAG, mobile learning apps, and serverless payment systems used by 50+ clients. On weekends I build at hackathons — fourteen projects and counting, including a DeltaHacks win.
Right now I'm studying Computing at the University of Guelph and building AI systems at Backboard.io.

featuredProjects.subtitle: Real-time triage from a camera feed · 2026
featuredProjects.description: Turns camera feeds into real-time biometric data and vital signs via Presage, with an ElevenLabs + Gemini first-aid voice operator and an ER-ready dashboard generating standardized SBAR reports — cutting diagnosis and handoff time by 10%.

featuredProjects.subtitle: Hadith as cinematic visual stories · 2026
featuredProjects.description: An AI-powered Islamic learning platform that transforms authentic Hadith into contextualized, cinematic visual stories — built to help younger generations connect more deeply with Islamic knowledge.

featuredProjects.name: Sentry

featuredProjects.description: An IDE extension that watches code in real time to catch vulnerabilities like exposed API keys — it locks the workflow, highlights the exact line, and recommends secure fixes. "Fix with Sentry" sends the context to Bob to auto-generate a remediation.

featuredProjects.name: EduPro
featuredProjects.subtitle: An intelligent tutoring system · 2025
featuredProjects.description: A tutoring system for grades 1–4 with personalized math practice, AI-generated hints, adaptive difficulty, and progress tracking for students, teachers, and parents. Built in two weeks by a team of six.

experience.description: Engineered an AI customer-support chatbot with FastAPI and RAG (vector embeddings, async processing, prompt engineering) that automates 65% of common inquiries, with real-time WebSocket messaging and conversation persistence. Built a data-protection system with automated PII detection and redaction plus ML confidence scoring for handoff to human agents — 100% secure handling via a modular AI inference layer on Azure OpenAI. Stack: Python, TypeScript, React, SQLite, Azure.

Built an interactive audio playback feature — click-to-hear pronunciation for 30+ learners with ML-generated feedback, improving learning accuracy by 40%. Reorganized components into shared, reusable React Native modules — cutting code duplication by 30% and improving cross-platform maintainability. Stack: React, React Native, JavaScript, CSS.

Engineered a serverless inventory tracking and management system adopted by 50+ clients, with event-driven Stripe integration for overdue charge recovery — dynamic retry logic and real-time alerts accelerated resolution times by 75%. Built payment and inventory dashboards using WebSockets for instant data sync, and worked directly with clients to gather requirements and keep teams aligned. Stack: Python, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, AWS, React.
